about_the_game:
In the dazzling and extravagant city of New York, the allure of the runway's spotlight draws countless dreamers. A 19-year-old girl, Lindsay Su, carries her dream of becoming a supermodel and ventures alone to New York City in pursuit of success.

Participating in modeling competitions, walking high-fashion shows, endorsing luxury jewelry brands...

As Lindsay Su steps into the vast world of the fashion industry, she quickly discovers that the truth behind the glamour is far more ruthless than it appears. The rivalries and scheming among models, the relentless struggle and sweat behind the runway—only she knows that any choice she makes could lead to a single misstep, plunging her into an abyss. Will Lindsay's hard-earned resilience help her find her footing in this chaotic race for fame and fortune?

A genius photographer, Ciang Jiang.

A world-class stylist, Elliot Graham.

The CEO of IME Model Agency, Nathaniel Sharp.

A top male supermodel, Ethan Tanner.

Among these four men of vastly different characters, who will Lindsay choose?

A perfect life, shining like a diamond, begins at this very moment—your story starts now!

Game Features：

1.Immersive Story Experience

Step into the shoes of Lindsay Su, a young girl with dreams of becoming a model. From an ordinary girl to a rising supermodel, experience the fierce competition and hardships of the fashion world, and uncover the reality behind the glamorous facade.

2.Multiple Choices Affect the Ending

Every choice you make will shape the story, character relationships, and the final outcome. Will you become a top supermodel, or will you be trapped in hidden rules? The decision is in your hands.

3.Realistic Depiction of the Fashion World

Participate in top model competitions, walk in haute couture fashion shows, and endorse luxury jewelry. Feel the glow of being a supermodel and the struggles behind the scenes, authentically recreating the brilliance and cruelty of the New York fashion scene.

Game Rules：

1.Choice-Driven Narrative Mechanism

Make decisions by clicking or selecting dialogue options to determine the direction of the story. Every choice affects character affinity, career progress, and future story branches.

2.Interaction and Bonds

Engage in deep interactions with multiple romanceable characters, building different relationships through dialogue and actions. Each character's affinity will uniquely influence the storyline.

3.Scandals and Public Opinion

Experience the pressure of public opinion in the modeling industry. Your actions may be exposed by journalists, leading to scandalous rumors. Use strategic choices and tasks to resolve negative PR crises.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows7 32bit equivalent or better
  • Processor: Intel® i3-3220, AMD FX 6300 equivalent or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ATI Radeon 2400 or higher / NVIDIA 8600M or higher / Intel HD Graphics 3000
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: This is an interactive RPG where players guide Lindsay, a young aspiring supermodel, through a modeling competition in New York. Face challenges, betrayals, and emotional growth as your choices shape her relationships, career, and future. Explore the glamorous yet dark side of the fashion world.
supported_languages:
English, French, German, Russian, Indonesian, Thai, Simplified Chinese*, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese
*languages with full audio support
